title: A metric offset of 0.024 would have been reported as a TTA effect

root_cause: Two matchers disagree, and an arm compared across matchers attributes the difference to the treatment.
correction_made: Every arm including a plain no-augmentation baseline runs through one matcher, and an Ultralytics re-measurement is reported alongside, so the offset is a number rather than an assumption.
